'''Baron Vardus''' is a [[human]] member of the [[Syndicate]], found in the Syndicate camps of the [[Uplands]] or the basement of the [[Strahnbrad]] Inn in the [[Alterac Mountains]]. He is a former noble of [[Alterac (kingdom)|Alterac]] and is now quartermaster of the Syndicate.

Baron Vardus contracted assassins to kill [[Magistrate Henry Maleb]]. Both Maleb and [[High Executor Darthalia]] want Vardus' head.

==Abilities==
* '''Frostbolt''' — Inflicts Frost damage to an enemy and reduces its movement speed for 4 sec.
* '''Frost Nova''' — Inflicts Frost damage to nearby enemies, immobilizing them for up to 8 sec.
* '''Backhand''' — Backhands an enemy, stunning it for 2 sec.

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Head of Baron Vardus]] for {{Questlong|Alliance|40|Baron's Demise}} and {{Questlong|Horde|40|WANTED: Baron Vardus}}.
